identity_boundary: The trusted local driver assigns process identities; message text cannot grant a role.

researcher.input: validated task and the same original two-clause policy
researcher.stop: valid candidate accepted, lease expired, deadline or root budget reached

executor.input: closed research candidate and unchanged task/policy digests
executor.stop: bounded engine outcome or interruption; unresolved effects retain stable operation ID

verifier.input: closed execution candidate, fresh read-only business/session state and task
verifier.stop: checks pass or explicit rejection with evidence; cannot create or approve a ticket
